description: This bar chart, from the paper "MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs," illustrates the F1 Score (%) for three variants of the MADLLM model across four datasets: PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score in percentage, ranging from 80 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10, and the horizontal axis lists the datasets. Each dataset has three grouped bars corresponding to the model variants: MADLLM (light green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). For the PSM dataset, the F1 scores are approximately 97% for MADLLM, 94% for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and 93% for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For the SWaT dataset, the scores are approximately 92% for MADLLM, 86% for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and 86% for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For the SMAP dataset, the scores are approximately 94% for MADLLM, 91% for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and 91% for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For the MSL dataset, the scores are approximately 93% for MADLLM, 90% for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and 89% for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The bars are grouped by dataset and are not sorted; the legend in the top-left corner identifies each color. There is a partial, gray bar at the far left of the horizontal axis, which is unlabeled and appears to be a placeholder or artifact.
